fields.valuationUse: Core operating scale, growth base, and margin denominator.
fields.periodExpectations: Annual and quarterly duration facts; TTM may be constructed from comparable quarters.
fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsIncluded: Provider-reported net revenue after ordinary revenue recognition adjustments.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: Segment mix, backlog, and non-financial operating KPIs.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Filed concepts can differ by company presentation and may require fallback tags.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo-normalized revenue can reflect provider restatement and statement normalization.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: SEC maps filed XBRL concepts; Yahoo maps normalized statement keys.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Required for valuation; missing revenue blocks primary-filing use and falls back when allowed.

fields.valuationUse: Current operating profitability and margin base.

fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsIncluded: Reported operating income according to provider statement mapping.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No autonomous normalization for one-time items, R&D capitalization, leases, or SBC.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Filed OperatingIncomeLoss reflects company taxonomy presentation.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo may normalize statement rows and can differ from filed operating income.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Yahoo EBIT aliases may not equal filed operating income for every issuer.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Required for primary-filing use; missing value downgrades source quality.

fields.valuationUse: Debt cost diagnostics and accounting context.
fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No autonomous debt-cost override or lease reclassification.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Interest presentation can vary between operating and non-operating facts.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo-normalized interest expense can be absent or sign-normalized.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Provider sign conventions and classification can differ.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Leave missing/report-only unless required by a tested downstream path.

fields.valuationUse: Effective tax-rate diagnostics and tax interpretation context.
fields.periodExpectations: Annual and quarterly duration facts aligned with pretax income.
fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No autonomous tax-rate change or NOL modeling.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Tax benefits can carry sign and classification complexity.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo tax fields may be normalized or absent.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Sign conventions can affect implied effective tax interpretation.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Use service marginal tax fallback where applicable and report source limitation.

fields.valuationUse: Effective tax-rate denominator and profitability context.
fields.periodExpectations: Annual and quarterly duration facts aligned with tax provision.
fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No autonomous normalization for unusual items.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Concept can vary based on continuing operations and noncontrolling interest presentation.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo may choose a normalized income-before-tax key.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Tax-rate interpretation changes materially when sign or income basis differs.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Effective tax calculation falls back to country marginal tax when unavailable.

fields.valuationUse: Accounting cleanup diagnostics and possible explicit governed R&D scenario support.
fields.periodExpectations: Annual duration history preferred; quarterly duration facts can support TTM.
fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsIncluded: Reported R&D expense when separately disclosed.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No automatic capitalization in autonomous researched mode.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Some issuers do not separately tag R&D or present it in combined lines.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo may omit R&D or map it differently across industries.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Missing R&D from one provider while another has material R&D is a report limitation.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Preserve missing status; do not convert missing R&D into analyzed cleanup.

fields.periodExpectations: Average shares for the income statement period.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: Point-in-time shares outstanding and options/warrants adjustment.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Average-share concepts are not equivalent to point-in-time shares.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo may omit average shares or provide provider-normalized share rows.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Average shares must not be mixed with point-in-time shares without warning.

fields.periodExpectations: Average diluted shares for the income statement period.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: Point-in-time shares outstanding and explicit option-value adjustments.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Diluted average shares can differ materially from current shares outstanding.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo may provide normalized share rows or omit diluted shares.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Average shares are period measures, while valuation per-share output uses share-count bridge assumptions.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Leave missing and preserve report-only dilution caveat.

fields.periodExpectations: Instant fact at or near the latest balance sheet date.
fields.commonAdjustmentsIncluded: Current common shares outstanding where available.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: Average shares, option dilution, warrants, and treasury method adjustments.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: DEI shares are point-in-time and may not align with average income statement periods.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo share count can come from market data or normalized statement fields.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Share-count basis differences can alter per-share valuation output.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Report missing share-count bridge; do not invent shares.

fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsIncluded: Reported stockholders' equity according to source mapping.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No autonomous lease, R&D, or minority-interest restatement.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Equity including noncontrolling interest can differ from common equity.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo equity rows may include or exclude minority interest depending on provider mapping.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Book equity is context, not a direct autonomous valuation override.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Leave missing or zero according to existing service behavior and report limitation.

fields.valuationUse: Claims bridge from enterprise value to equity value.
fields.periodExpectations: Instant balance sheet fact; current plus noncurrent synthesis only when total debt is absent.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo total debt is provider-normalized and may include lease obligations.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Debt classification can differ materially between filed tags and normalized provider rows.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Preserve missing status; direct debt overrides remain blocked in autonomous researched mode.

fields.valuationUse: Claims bridge from enterprise value to equity value.

fields.commonAdjustmentsIncluded: Reported cash, equivalents, and short-term investments where available.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.sec: Combined tag may be absent and require cash plus short-term investment synthesis.
adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo may normalize cash and short-term investments into a single row.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Cash classification can differ when short-term investments are separate.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Preserve missing status; direct cash overrides remain blocked in autonomous researched mode.

fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No autonomous minority-interest adjustment beyond existing service fields.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo can omit or normalize minority-interest rows.

fields.knownProviderDifferences: Missing/present mismatches can affect claims interpretation.
fields.fallbackBehaviorWhenMissing: Treat as missing or zero according to existing service behavior and report limitation.

fields.valuationUse: SBC and dilution diagnostics; report-only in autonomous researched mode.
fields.periodExpectations: Annual duration history preferred; quarterly duration facts can support TTM.
fields.unitExpectations: Monetary value in the financial statement currency.
fields.commonAdjustmentsIncluded: Reported share-based compensation add-back where available.
fields.commonAdjustmentsExcluded: No autonomous dilution or SBC adjustment in researched mode.

adjustmentRisksByProvider.yahoo: Yahoo may omit SBC or normalize it under alternate cash-flow keys.
